motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All list items and buttons must have explicit hover states (e.g., bg-white/5 or border-blue-500).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Slide up for new views (files, commits), slide left/right for tabs. Use framer-motion AnimatePresence if in React.

accessibility.contrast: Text must maintain 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text is zinc-400 against black, which passes. Yellow accents ensure high visibility for data.
accessibility.focus_rings: focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 on all interactive elements.

login_background.description: Abstract green digital pattern with vertical lines - used behind the token login screen.
login_background.usage: Cover image with black gradient overlay to ensure text readability.

code_placeholder.description: Computer screen displaying lines of code.
code_placeholder.usage: Use as a placeholder header image in the user profile or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: TECH STACK OVERRIDE: The problem stated 'React Native Expo' but the system environment enforces 'React js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui'. Build a React Web application that SIMULATES a mobile application interface.
Wrap the main application in a mobile-simulator container: <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-md h-[100dvh] bg-black relative shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react). They fit the developer aesthetic perfectly. Use weight='duotone' for active tabs, 'regular' for files.
Do NOT use generic card components with rounded corners and soft shadows. Use purely flat, sharp-edged (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) borders. Tech Brutalism.
Ensure all routing changes (Tabs vs Stack pushes) are smooth. A mobile app feels fast because it doesn't do full page reloads. Use standard state-based views.
File Viewer MUST use `JetBrains Mono` or similar monospace font. Make it dense.
Commit Histories should use a vertical timeline layout (border-l).
Ensure every interactive element has a `data-testid`.
